name: Creative re-render upscale (SD3.5, experimental)
author: ComfyQ
description:
An upscaler that re-renders your picture through Stability's SD3.5 Large rather than restoring it, using their blur ControlNet to hold the composition. This is the approach Magnific made famous.

READ THIS FIRST: on the tests run when this was built, the SeedVR2 upscaler beat it clearly on both a claymation still and a photographic portrait - SeedVR2 resolved individual hair strands cleanly where this produced coarse clumps and a faint canvas-weave texture across flat areas like skin. For ordinary "make this sharper and bigger", reach for SeedVR2 first. This is here because it does something different: it genuinely re-imagines, so it can invent detail on material that is too far gone for a restorer, and it responds to a prompt.

Its real limit is size. SD3.5 Large is trained at about 1 megapixel and degrades above that - with the ControlNet off at 2 MP it collapses into blocky noise entirely. The ControlNet masks most of that, but the picture still softens past roughly 1.5 MP. So this is for taking something small up to about 1-1.5 MP, not for making posters.

WRITE A PROMPT describing the subject. It is a text-to-image model underneath and the prompt decides what the invented detail is made of.

Leave creativity at 1.0. Lower values start from your blurry picture and keep its blur, which defeats the point. Resemblance at 0.9 is the sweet spot; much lower and the model starts weaving a canvas texture into flat areas.

Any input size works, odd numbers and extreme panoramas included: the picture is scaled to the megapixels you ask for with the aspect ratio kept and the dimensions snapped to the 16-pixel grid the model needs.

exposedParameters.label: Output size in megapixels (the model was trained at 1; past about 1.5 it goes soft)
Creativity - leave at 1.0; below about 0.8 it keeps the blur it was meant to remove
Resemblance - 0.9 works; below about 0.7 it invents a canvas-weave texture
What is in the picture - describing it genuinely improves the result
exposedParameters.default: a sharp, high quality photograph, fine natural detail, realistic texture

exposedParameters.label: Negative prompt - what to avoid
exposedParameters.default: blurry, soft focus, low quality, jpeg artifacts, oversharpened, plastic skin, waxy

exposedParameters.label: Steps (25 is plenty; raise it only if detail looks unfinished)
Seed - change it to invent different detail

warmupParams.cliptextencode_text_5: a sharp, high quality photograph, fine natural detail, realistic texture

promptGuides.label: Stability AI - SD3.5 Large ControlNet Blur (the upscaling model)
promptGuides.tip: Describe the subject plainly. The blur ControlNet carries the structure; the prompt decides what the invented detail is made of.
